feedback_summary: The candidate successfully identifies the major data points from the chart (Coal, Natural Gas, Oil, Hydro) and correctly notes the highest and lowest sources. However, the script falls into Band 2 due to a high density of spelling and grammatical errors, mechanical line-by-line listing, omission of the 2% nuclear figure, and the insertion of external opinions and facts not present in the graph.
